note: A12.1. Proves the generic form (IProducer<K, V> / ProducerBuilder<K, V> / Message<K, V>) reaches a real graph node. Single dir on purpose: the point is the CELL, not a pairing. The packet spec keyed the node as the framework tag `queue_producer:kafka`; that predates A2.2 (`.ProduceAsync(` reads the literal) and A2.3 (the tag is now `queue_producer:unresolved:kafka`), so the node is `queue_producer:orders` and the tag is forbidden. The BootstrapServers literal is realistic but no longer load-bearing: since A2.2 the gate is case-insensitive and `using Confluent.Kafka;` passes it. Generics use canonical `<Null, OrderCreated>` spacing (A15.8 handoff).
